text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Pleeease! Onee-chan! Let's go shopping 
together~!

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you mention you have a pop quiz 
coming up?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That'll be totally fine~♡ Onee-chan, let's 
go on a date~♡

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text: Urgh...!

text_block_list.name: Strict Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
No. It's times like this where I, as the 
elder sister, have to stay firm. I must 
tell her sternly.

text_block_list.name: Overprotective Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
But we haven't gone on our usual monthly 
date yet, and we haven't bought matching 
items either—

text_block_list.name: Overprotective Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
Look! Vivlos's favorite brand just 
released a new line of cosmetics, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Overprotective Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
She's not going to get a bad score on the 
test anyway. If it's just a little change 
of pace—

text_block_list.name: Strict Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
Even so! Studying isn't just for the sake 
of getting good grades.

text_block_list.name: Strict Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
It's an act of cultivating planning 
skills, perseverance, curiosity toward the 
unknown... all sorts of virtues.

text_block_list.name: Strict Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
If she only learns how to pamper herself 
with others' indulgence and ruins her 
future...

text_block_list.name: Strict Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
If that were to happen... as her elder 
sister, I—!

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos... Let's hold off on our outing 
until after your quiz is over.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Eeeh, why, why~?!

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
It's merely a quiz, yet it's still a quiz. 
Tomorrow is built upon the accumulation of 
daily efforts.

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
I want you to lead a brilliant future... 
and I know you can do it if you try.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Our future, huh... You're exaggerating, 
Onee-chan.

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
That's just how serious I am about you. 
...Do you understand?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Okaaaay. I'll do my best, so... will 
you go on a loooong date with me once it's 
over?

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We'll go out and buy matching things 
too. ...It's a promise.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the library where I came to gather 
research materials, I saw a horse girl 
staring fondly at a mechanical pencil.

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.
choice_data_list: Is that something precious to you?
Is that something precious to you?

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Oh dear. Was it showing on my 
face...?

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
So she'll do her best studying... it 
matches with my precious little sister's. 
Fufu.
